comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
These are used for a particular imperial quest so you use them to farm patriot awards it its not uncommon to see these sell at 100k or even 200k as they allow you to earn a good amount of PA's from the IQ. Sometimes you may find for cheaper just gotta look...

Another use
These horses are also pretty decent value not extreme but Decent and since they have 0 unit cost because they were caught in the the wild they are all profit therefore the entire value earns you trade xp. Not sure if livestock room ship skill works on this... Maybe someone can test

wiki:
Obtainable with Procurement Rank 7 from the following land zones:

Europe:
South Calais
France Northwest Coast
South Nantes

East Asia:
Edo North
Japanese Archipelago West Coast
Korean Peninsula North Coast
Korean Peninsula West Coast / Northern Kongju
